text: My daily routine is built on consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six thirty every morning, and my first habit is drinking a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I eat a simple breakfast of oatmeal and fruit. My work schedule starts at nine, and I usually focus on my most difficult tasks in the morning. Around noon, I take a short break to walk outside. In the afternoon, I have meetings and answer emails. I finish work by six, then go to the gym or run in the park for about forty minutes. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a bit, and watch one episode of a show. By ten thirty, I’m in bed, ready to repeat the same steady rhythm tomorrow.
